scope: Independent reading of root-authored CantrellAlgebra and CantrellSupports; subsequent conjugate-factor repair in Algebra and new Angle module were authored by this reviewer, so those additions are not independently reviewed by their author.

findings.detail: The polynomial has a unique root in [6.59861960924436,6.59861960924437]. The shifted derivative is strictly negative throughout [0,1], which contains the shifted isolating interval. No global packing conclusion is in this theorem.

Originally only quartic-root implies degree-eight-root was proved. A degree-eight root does not automatically solve the intended radical quartic. Added exact positivity of the conjugate factor throughout the interval and proved candidateSide_quartic. Its new successful build is 20261014_160506_be2ba390; no native/sorry assumptions.
Four directed gaps telescope to 3+c+s. Coordinate constraints give x31−x6≤L−4 and y6−y31≤L−3. For nonnegative c,s their weighted sum yields exactly 3+4c+5s≤(c+s)L. All assumptions are explicit.

Left projections U≥c+3s+3/2−sL and V≥s+2c+3/2 are weighted by c−s and c+s. Under 0≤s≤c and c²+s²=1 this gives x13+y13≥3+3c+s(c−s)(5−L). Explicit reflection gives the corresponding upper bound for x22+y22; two central support gaps give the second inequality.

rightLabels is not a permutation of all naturals, but the theorem makes no such claim: it substitutes only the five LeftBrace labels, mapped to five distinct relevant labels. It does not silently assume that the original 37-square packing is symmetric.

Two exact support equalities and the unit-direction equation yield two quadratic equations. The resultant identity and nonzero 24−16sqrt(2) imply the selected quartic vanishes. The interval hypothesis then identifies the root. This does not convert support inequalities into equalities or establish a minimax bound by itself.

remaining_for_global_37: A theorem reducing every arbitrary packing below candidateSide to these same labelled common-angle directed support assumptions, or an exhaustive alternative-family elimination. None of Algebra, Supports, FiniteCover, or an angle minimax theorem supplies it.
remaining_for_exact_attainment: A full 37-square layout at the exact algebraic side still needs its own containment and 666-pair disjointness proof. A rational packing at a slightly larger side only proves that larger upper bound.
